title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Strengthening Coordination and Cooperation to Actively Promote the Reform of Sentencing Standardization
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of State Security, Ministry of Justice

Notice on Strengthening Coordination and Cooperation to Actively Advance the Reform for Standardizing Sentencing

Fa Fa [2010] No. 47

To the High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), State Security Departments (Bureaus), and Justice Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court and Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate, Public Security Bureau, State Security Bureau, and Justice Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

"Standardizing the discretion of adjudication and incorporating sentencing into court trial procedures" (hereinafter referred to as the reform for standardizing sentencing) is a major judicial reform project established by the Central Committee. In accordance with the overall deployment and requirements of the Central Committee for deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms, and on the basis of in-depth investigation, research, and extensive solicitation of opinions from all sides, the Supreme People's Court formulated the "Guiding Opinions of the People's Courts on Sentencing (Trial Implementation)," and the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, and the Ministry of Justice jointly formulated the "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Standardization of Sentencing Procedures (Trial Implementation)." With the approval of the Central Committee, the reform for standardizing sentencing will be fully implemented nationwide from October 1, 2010. In order to earnestly implement the major decisions and deployments of the Central Committee, actively advance the reform for standardizing sentencing, and ensure that the reform achieves results, we hereby notify the relevant issues as follows:

I. Fully Recognize the Important Significance of the Reform for Standardizing Sentencing and Comprehensively Carry Out the Reform for Standardizing Sentencing

1. The reform for standardizing sentencing is an important guarantee for standardizing the discretion of adjudication, achieving fairness and balance in sentencing, and enhancing the credibility and authority of law enforcement. It is an important measure for promoting the resolution of social conflicts, improving the innovation of social management, and promoting impartial and honest law enforcement. The reform for standardizing sentencing is a decision and deployment made by the Central Committee based on the new period and new situation, summarizing judicial practice experience earnestly, and listening to the people's call for judicial justice. The Central Committee's decision to implement the reform for standardizing sentencing is a positive response to the call of the times, the aspirations of the people, and the needs of reality. It concerns the support of the people and the ruling foundation of the Party. The main purpose of the reform is to further standardize judges' discretion in imposing penalties in criminal cases, to enhance the openness and transparency of sentencing by incorporating sentencing into court trial procedures, to unify the standards for the application of law, and to better implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity. The smooth implementation of this reform will be more conducive to accurately punishing criminal offenses according to law, to protecting citizens' litigation rights according to law, to maintaining social harmony and stability, and to the scientific development of criminal justice work. It is of great significance. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, state security organs, and judicial administrative organs at all levels must recognize the great significance of this decision and deployment of the Central Committee from an overall perspective, further unify their thinking, raise their awareness, carefully study the relevant documents, accurately grasp the content of the reform, actively carry out the reform for standardizing sentencing, and ensure good legal and social effects.

II. Update Law Enforcement Concepts, Strengthen Coordination and Cooperation, and Deepen the Reform for Standardizing Sentencing

2. Update the concept of criminal law enforcement. The reform for standardizing sentencing is a new task, which places new and higher demands on law enforcement personnel's law enforcement concepts, procedural awareness, and law enforcement capabilities. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, state security organs, and judicial administrative organs at all levels should, through in-depth education on the concept of socialist rule of law, thoroughly eliminate and abandon those outdated concepts that do not conform to or are incompatible with the requirements of the socialist concept of rule of law, firmly establish the socialist criminal law enforcement concept that equally emphasizes combating crime and protecting human rights, equally emphasizes conviction and sentencing, and equally emphasizes substantive justice and procedural justice, effectively improve the ability and level of law enforcement and case handling, and achieve the organic unity of legal effects and social effects in case handling.

3. Attach great importance to the work of investigation and evidence collection. Investigative organs and procuratorial organs should not only focus on collecting all kinds of evidence that prove the guilt or serious crime of the criminal suspect or defendant, but also focus on collecting all kinds of evidence that prove the innocence or minor crime of the criminal suspect or defendant; not only focus on collecting all kinds of statutory sentencing circumstances, but also focus on ascertaining various discretionary sentencing circumstances, such as the cause of the case, the fault of the victim, restitution and return of stolen goods, civil compensation, and the usual conduct of the criminal suspect or defendant, so as to ensure that the facts of conviction and sentencing are clear and the evidence is reliable and sufficient. Lay the foundation for standardized and fair sentencing, as well as for doing a good job in mediation and resolving social conflicts.

4. Further strengthen the work of examination and prosecution. When examining a case, a people's procuratorate should objectively and comprehensively examine the evidence of the case, focusing not only on examining evidence of conviction, but also on examining evidence of sentencing; focusing not only on examining statutory sentencing circumstances, but also on examining discretionary sentencing circumstances; focusing not only on examining aggravating sentencing circumstances, but also on examining circumstances for leniency, mitigation, or exemption from punishment. In the process of examining a case, it may request the investigative organ to provide various evidentiary materials related to sentencing that are necessary for court trial. The transfer of sentencing evidentiary materials shall be carried out in accordance with relevant provisions.

5. Fully implement various compulsory measures provided for in the Criminal Procedure Law. In investigative activities, for criminal suspects whose crimes are relatively minor and whose social harm is relatively small, if they meet the conditions for obtaining a guarantor pending trial or residential surveillance, compulsory measures such as obtaining a guarantor pending trial or residential surveillance should be applied as much as possible, reducing the application of custodial compulsory measures; when a people's procuratorate or people's court, in the process of examining a prosecution or trial, finds that the period of custody may exceed the sentence to be imposed, it may change the compulsory measures according to the circumstances of the case, to avoid the custody period exceeding the imposed sentence, and effectively protect the lawful rights and interests of the defendant.

6. Continue to improve the system of sentencing recommendations. Procuratorial organs should adhere to the principle of being active, cautious, and steady, moving from easy to difficult, practicing while summarizing, and gradually expanding the scope of application of cases. Sentencing recommendations should be made in a standard manner according to law, with attention to the quality and effect of the sentencing recommendation. When making a sentencing recommendation, a sentencing recommendation letter should generally be prepared. For summary procedure cases where the people's procuratorate does not send a representative to appear in court, a sentencing recommendation letter should be prepared. Sentencing recommendations should generally have a certain range, but for sensitive and complex cases, cases of social concern, cases involving national security and cases that seriously affect the stability of local areas, etc., specific sentencing recommendations may not be made, and only general recommendations such as heavier, lighter, or mitigated punishment according to law may be made.

7. Strengthen guidance for lawyers' defense work and increase efforts in legal aid. Judicial administrative organs and lawyers' associations at all levels should strengthen guidance for lawyers' defense work, improve the business rules for lawyers handling criminal cases, and standardize lawyers' professional conduct. When handling criminal cases, lawyers should perform their defense duties according to law and effectively safeguard the lawful rights and interests of criminal suspects and defendants. Judicial organs should fully protect lawyers' professional rights and attach importance to the sentencing evidence and sentencing opinions submitted by defense lawyers. Judicial administrative organs should further expand the scope of legal aid, increase investment in legal aid, strengthen the legal aid team, and provide legal aid as much as possible to those defendants who do not plead guilty or have disputes over sentencing recommendations, who are unable to appoint a defense lawyer due to financial difficulties or other reasons, so as to better protect the defendant's right to defense.

8. Further improve the quality and level of court trials. In court trials, the relative independence of the sentencing procedure should be guaranteed, and the order of investigation of conviction and sentencing facts and the focus of debate should be reasonably arranged. For cases where the defendant has no objection to the alleged criminal facts and charges, the investigation and debate may mainly focus on sentencing and other disputed issues; for cases where the defendant does not plead guilty or the defender makes a plea of not guilty, the facts of conviction and the facts of sentencing should be ascertained first, and then the debate should focus on the issues of conviction and sentencing. The public prosecutor and the defender should actively participate in court investigation and court debate. If the trial judge has doubts about the sentencing evidence, they may investigate and verify the evidence, and if necessary, may also request the people's procuratorate to supplement the investigation and verification. The people's procuratorate should supplement the investigation and verification of relevant evidence, and if necessary, may request the investigative organ to provide assistance.

III. Strengthen Organization and Coordination to Ensure the Effectiveness of the Reform for Standardizing Sentencing

9. Strengthen organizational leadership and form a joint work force. The reform for standardizing sentencing involves the overall situation of political and legal work. It must rely on the leadership of the Party committee, the supervision of the People's Congress, and the mutual support and cooperation of various political and legal departments to ensure that all reform measures are implemented. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, state security organs, and judicial administrative organs at all levels should attach great importance to it, strictly follow the deployment and requirements of the Central Committee, effectively strengthen organizational leadership, and earnestly grasp the implementation of the work. They should establish and improve a work liaison mechanism, strengthen mutual communication and coordination, form a joint work force, promptly coordinate and study solutions to problems and difficulties encountered in the process of reforming sentencing standardization, and ensure the smooth advancement of the reform for standardizing sentencing.

10. Strengthen professional training and improve quality and ability. The reform for standardizing sentencing places new and higher demands on investigation and evidence collection, examination and prosecution, lawyer defense, legal aid, and court trials. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, state security organs, and judicial administrative organs at all levels should, based on actual work conditions, through different channels and in different ways, strengthen professional training to ensure that relevant criminal case-handling personnel correctly understand the importance and necessity of the reform for standardizing sentencing, strengthen awareness of sentencing procedures, master scientific sentencing methods, continuously improve the ability and level of law enforcement and case handling, and ensure the quality of criminal case handling.

11. Increase publicity efforts and continuously summarize and improve. The reform for standardizing sentencing requires understanding and support from all sectors of society. Publicity and explanation work should be further strengthened, and the important significance and practical effects of the reform for standardizing sentencing should be actively disseminated, so that the people can fully feel the results brought about by the reform for standardizing sentencing. The reform for standardizing sentencing is currently in the pilot phase and requires a process of continuous summarization and improvement. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, state security organs, and judicial administrative organs at all levels should promptly summarize experiences, identify problems, and make improvements. Higher-level organs should strengthen supervision and guidance over lower-level organs, promptly grasp the progress of the work, effectively solve problems existing in the pilot work, and continuously improve the level of work on standardizing sentencing. For major issues, they should be promptly reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, and the Ministry of Justice. Next year, a comprehensive inspection and summary of the pilot work on standardizing sentencing in various regions will be conducted, the pilot documents will be revised and improved, and the reform for standardizing sentencing will be continuously deepened.

November 6, 2010
